name: The Island
extentNote: PLAN 5: from Heelsum in the west to Pannerden in the east, and from north of Arnhem to Groesbeek and Overasselt in the south. Widened to take in Ginkel Heath (DZ Y) in the north-west and the ground south of Groesbeek (DZ N).

builtUp.note: 1944 built-up area: BAG building footprints (PDOK) with bouwjaar up to maxYear. A hex is built-up when those footprints cover at least minFootprintShare of it, or when at least coreMinShare of it lies inside a settlement-core mask from the overrides file. Decision 0006.

crossings.name: Arnhem Road Bridge
crossings.fate: Held by Frost's force from 17 Sep evening to 21 Sep morning.

crossings.name: Arnhem Rail Bridge (Oosterbeek)
crossings.source: docs/history/map.md (Arnhem rail bridge); location: OSM Spoorbrug Oosterbeek

crossings.name: Arnhem pontoon bridge
crossings.fate: Centre section removed by the Germans; not crossable.

crossings.name: Heveadorp–Driel ferry
crossings.fate: Disabled by the ferryman on 20 Sep.

crossings.name: Nijmegen Road Bridge
crossings.fate: Prepared for demolition; taken intact on 20 Sep about 19:10.

crossings.name: Nijmegen Rail Bridge
crossings.fate: Captured on 20 Sep, two hours after the Waal crossing.
crossings.source: docs/history/map.md (Nijmegen bridges); location: OSM Spoorbrug Nijmegen

crossings.name: Grave bridge
crossings.fate: Taken intact by the 504th PIR on 17 Sep.

crossings.name: Heumen lock bridge
crossings.fate: Prepared for demolition but taken intact on 17 Sep; main XXX Corps route over the canal.

crossings.name: Malden bridge
crossings.fate: Blown on 17 Sep as American paratroopers reached it.
crossings.source: docs/history/map.md (Maas–Waal canal bridges); location: OSM Maldensebrug on the Blankenbergseweg

crossings.name: Hatert bridge
crossings.fate: Found demolished when attacked on 17 Sep.
crossings.source: docs/history/map.md (Maas–Waal canal bridges); location: OSM Hatertsebrug (rebuilt in the 1960s on the same road)

crossings.name: Honinghutje bridge
crossings.fate: Damaged by German demolitions when attacked; XXX Corps used the Heumen bridge instead.
crossings.source: docs/history/map.md (Maas–Waal canal bridges); location: OSM Graafsebrug on the Graafseweg, the main Grave–Nijmegen road

crossings.name: Mook rail bridge
crossings.fate: Blown by the Germans on 17 Sep as American patrols approached.
crossings.source: docs/history/map.md (Mook rail bridge); location: OSM Spoorbrug Mook

crossings.name: Pannerden ferry
crossings.fate: Set up by 10th SS engineers on 18 Sep; used to move the division to Nijmegen.
crossings.source: docs/history/map.md (Pannerden ferry); location: OSM Pannerden–Doornenburg ferry across the Pannerdensch Kanaal

mainRoute.note: The Club Route as far as the sources give it: from the south edge over the Grave bridge, the Heumen lock bridge and the Nijmegen road bridge, through Elst to the Arnhem road bridge. docs/history/map.md (Club Route).
